label: The MTBF formula
subgoals: Multiply its inverse by e to the resolution time over tau
Take log base ten to compare magnitudes

label: Resolution time in a two-flop synchronizer
section: Resolution time in a two-flop synchronizer
subgoals: Start from one clock period between the two flip-flops
Subtract clock-to-q of the first flop and setup of the second
Insert the resolution time into the MTBF formula

label: Adding stages to meet a target
section: Adding stages to meet a target
subgoals: Multiply the per-stage resolution time by the number of stages minus one
Compute log base ten of the MTBF for each candidate stage count
Pick the smallest stage count meeting the target
